Title: Move warehouse man
Description: The movement can only move horizontally or vertically
Author: GARCÍA RODRÍGUEZ, DANIEL

Title: Detect when level is completed
Description: To win a level, all boxes must be on goal positions. So it must check that every time a box is moved
Author: GARCÍA RODRÍGUEZ, DANIEL

Title: Setup board based on level file
Author: GARCÍA RODRÍGUEZ, DANIEL

Title: Box movement
Description: When a collision with a box is detected, if movement is possible, move it.
Author: GARCÍA RODRÍGUEZ, DANIEL

Title: Restore the cell type when the warehouse man is moved from that cell
Description:
For example: If the warehouse is in a goal cell, in the game must apear only the warehouse man. But, once it moves, the cell must return to the image it had before.
It only apply to the warehouse man, because the warehouse man moves to the cell where the box had been before it had been pushed.
Author: GARCÍA RODRÍGUEZ, DANIEL

Title: Scoring system
Description:
The score must be the steps it takes to finish the level.
The movement into a wall should count as a step??
Author: GARCÍA RODRÍGUEZ, DANIEL

Title: Temporary TUI for the game
Description: We will use a Terminal User Interface temporarily before building the final GUI. It will show one level and will detect user input.
Author: COLLADO TOMÉ, IVÁN

Title: Restart level
Description: Add a restart level action so the player can restart the level to its initial state.
Author: COLLADO TOMÉ, IVÁN

Title: Validate level files before loading
Description:
Level files should be valid when loading and show an error otherwise, specifications:

- There are at least one box and one goal position
- There is only one warehouse man
- The board contains the same number of boxes and goal positions. If the level is not correct, the application must spot it, showing an error message and trying to read the next level.
Author: COLLADO TOMÉ, IVÁN

Title: Detect and handle player collisions
Description: The warehouse man shouldn't be able to push boxes into walls, walk into them and push boxes into other boxes.
Author: COLLADO TOMÉ, IVÁN

Title: Transition to a GUI
Description:
Transition from a TUI to the final GUI with the board showing:

- The board
- The level name
- The punctuation of the level
- The punctuation of the game
Author: COLLADO TOMÉ, IVÁN

Title: Change level visuals based on context
Description:
'- Two or more consecutive walls should have the aspect of being only one piece
- When a box is placed in a goal position, the color of the box must change to show that it in a goal
position
Author: COLLADO TOMÉ, IVÁN

Title: Game menu
Description:
The game menu of the application must allow the user to:
- Start a new game, that is, reset the game and starts again from the first level
- Restart the current level
- Undo the last movement
- Save the game
- Open a saved game
- Close the application
Author: COLLADO TOMÉ, IVÁN

Title: Go to next level when winning one
Description: Go to next level if available
Author: COLLADO TOMÉ, IVÁN

Title: Victory message when finishing
Description: When there are no more levels show a congratulations message with the punctuation of the run
Author: COLLADO TOMÉ, IVÁN

Title: Complete window/Same size window
Description: Instead of having different sizes every level and menus, having the same one for all
Author: GARCÍA RODRÍGUEZ, DANIEL

Description:
> The different levels are read from files with name level N.txt, where N is a positive number.

Description:
Requirement 15:
